name: com.elringus.spritedicing
displayName: SpriteDicing (runtime subset recovered from the shipped build)
description: Only what the shipped game's IL2CPP metadata still contains of Elringus' SpriteDicing runtime: SpriteDicing.DicedSpriteAtlas (sprites, textures, GetSprite). Installing this package defines SPRITE_DICING_AVAILABLE for Naninovel (versionDefines of Elringus.Naninovel.Runtime), which enables its DicedSprite actors and the game's DicedSpriteCharacterExtended.
